purpose: Independent fixed-step NEURON active eleven-channel reference for the frozen Task30b early-exposure design; first establish the exact-formula-to-native floor before any learned-model verdict.
decision: Native active reference is admissible only if 32/32 episodes are finite, 24/24 non-rest episodes are exposed before 8ms, every canonical channel is compiled at the pinned teacher revision, and the formula-vs-native 8ms pooled/worst floor is <=0.2/0.5mV. Only then assess both frozen families and each of three seeds against <=1/2mV candidate-vs-native 8ms pooled/worst thresholds. Report event crossings and longer horizons but never use them for selection. Failure of native floor is a solver or protocol mismatch, not a learned-model NO-GO.
scope: Single compartment, all eleven original NMODL channel mechanisms, imposed fixed cai and reversals, external current. No CaDynamics, axial coupling, synapses, morphology or speed claim. Task31 authorization requires a separate decision; Gate D compiled performance NO-GO unchanged.
